note: Ireland keeps its own list, outside Schengen: the Immigration Act 2004 (Visas) Order 2014 (S.I. 473/2014), whose Schedule 1 names the nationalities that land without a visa, as amended. The list is the Immigration Service's of May 2025 (after S.I. 68/2025 and S.I. 164/2025 moved Eswatini, Lesotho, Nauru and Trinidad and Tobago to visas), less Nicaragua, Saint Kitts and Nevis and Saint Lucia, which S.I. 242/2026 moved to visas from 15 June 2026. The United Kingdom in all its nationality classes is exempt (Schedule 1 names it with the British Overseas Territories and Crown Dependencies), so every British territory's passport is free; the Faroes' passport is listed apart as needing a visa. Ireland sets no number of days in the list: the stay is the permission an immigration officer grants at landing.
